description: Implementation of WebSocketEndpointLockManager class managing endpoint locking with delay, including lock acquisition, release, and delayed unlocking logic.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager
classes.description: Manages locking and unlocking of WebSocket endpoints with delay to prevent DoS attacks.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::Waiter
classes.description: Represents a waiter for endpoint lock.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::LockReleaser
classes.description: Handles releasing of endpoint lock, ensuring proper unlock and cleanup.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::LockInfo
classes.description: Stores lock state and queue of waiters for each endpoint.

methods.name: LockEndpoint
methods.description: Attempts to lock an endpoint; returns OK if successful or ERR_IO_PENDING if waiting.

methods.name: UnlockEndpoint
methods.description: Releases the lock on an endpoint and initiates delayed unlock.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the lock info map is empty.

methods.name: SetUnlockDelayForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom delay for unlocking, used for testing.

methods.name: RegisterLockReleaser
methods.description: Associates a LockReleaser with an endpoint.

methods.name: UnlockEndpointAfterDelay
methods.description: Schedules delayed unlocking of an endpoint.

methods.name: DelayedUnlockEndpoint
methods.description: Performs the actual unlock after delay, activating next waiter if any.
